title: MetNet: neural rainfall forecasting up to 8 hours ahead
summary: The model forecasts precipitation at 1 km resolution and 2-minute intervals up to 8 hours ahead from radar and satellite, without physical equations. According to the page, it outperforms NOAA’s operational HRRR model up to about 7–8 hours, in seconds rather than about an hour. US coverage only, author-only comparisons, a preprint, and no stated operational use.
